packageRules.description: Keep the cf build and Workers test runtimes together, including prereleases.
Select ordered Vite plugin betas so the shared release-age filter can choose a mature release even when the beta tag is newer. Review other release series manually.
ai and the @ai-sdk packages each pin one exact @ai-sdk/provider-utils; updated apart, ai and @ai-sdk/valibot can resolve different copies whose Schema types differ, and inference fails typecheck.
Review compiler upgrades alongside the shared preset's peer requirements.
